arena: [생존기] With Overpowered Barrier, Blazing Barrier absorbs 60% more and reflects 40% of absorbed damage, but lasts only 4 sec. Pop it the moment the enemy pops their burst cooldowns.

[생존기] Cauterize keeps you alive at 35% health when you take fatal damage, and while you burn for 6 sec you ignore slows and gain 150% movement speed. Run behind a pillar to break line of sight meanwhile.
[생존기] Ice Block prevents all attacks and damage for 10 sec, but you can't attack, move or cast meanwhile. Use it when you take burst with Cauterize already used.
[회피] Blink teleports you 20 yds forward and frees you from all stuns and roots. When a melee DPS stuns you, get out immediately and gain distance.
[제어] Dragon's Breath disorients enemies within 12 yds in front of you for 4 sec but damage breaks it. Use it on melee DPS on top of you, don't hit them, and gain distance.

[제어] With Master Shepherd, your movement speed increases by 25% while an enemy player is in your Polymorph, and Polymorph doesn't heal the enemy. Sheep the enemy healer and pop Combustion on another target to burst.
[차단] Counterspell interrupts a cast and locks that school for 7 sec. Save it for the enemy healer's heals.
[분담] With Improved Mass Invisibility, Mass Invisibility every 2 min also affects allies in combat within 40 yds, making them invisible for 12 sec. Pull everyone out when your team gets collapsed on.
bg: [참고] On flag maps, if a healer can't carry, a mobile DPS carries. When you have the flag, break stuns and roots with Blink and keep Blazing Barrier up without gaps.
[제어] Ice Wall was picked by 29 of 41 Battleground Blitz players, and its 30 yd wall blocks line of sight for up to 15 sec. Cut line of sight for enemies chasing your carrier or for the enemy healer.
[제어] Enemies disoriented by Dragon's Breath can't be knocked back. Use it on enemies trying to capture a base, but don't overlap it with your team's knockbacks.
[제어] Ring of Frost places a ring for 10 sec that incapacitates up to 10 enemies entering it for 10 sec. Drop it next to the base flag you're guarding to lock down enemies coming to capture.
[분담] With Improved Mass Invisibility, Mass Invisibility also affects allies in combat. When losing a teamfight, make allies within 40 yds invisible for 12 sec and move to the next base.
[생존기] Healing taken is reduced by 20% in battlegrounds. Rather than waiting on heals, use Blazing Barrier and Alter Time right before the burst.
pvpTalents: Overpowered Barrier, picked by all top 41 Solo Shuffle players, increases Blazing Barrier absorbs by 60% and reflects 40% of absorbed damage, but lasts only 4 sec. Improved Mass Invisibility, picked by 40 of 41 Solo Shuffle players and all 27 3v3 players, reduces Mass Invisibility's cooldown by 3 min and lets it affect allies in combat. Master Shepherd, picked by 35 of 41 Solo Shuffle players, grants 25% movement speed and 12% Versatility while an enemy player is in your Polymorph.

1953.m: 2% of base mana · Instant · 20 sec cooldown · 1 Charge
1953.d: Teleports you forward 20 yds or until reaching an obstacle, and frees you from all stuns and bonds.

31661.m: Talent · 4% of base mana · Instant · 45 sec cooldown
31661.d:
Enemies in a 12 yd cone in front of you take (66.99% of Spell Power) Fire damage and are disoriented for 4 sec. Damage will cancel the effect.

Always deals a critical strike and contributes to Hot Streak.

113724.m: Talent · 8% of base mana · 30 yd range · 2 sec cast · 45 sec cooldown
113724.d:
Summons a Ring of Frost for 10 sec at the target location. Enemies entering the ring are incapacitated for 10 sec. Limit 10 targets.

When the incapacitate expires, enemies are slowed by 65% for 4 sec.

352278.m: Tank Specs – Row 1 PvP Talent · 8% of base mana · 30 yd range · 1.5 sec cast · 1.5 min cooldown
352278.d: Conjures an Ice Wall 30 yards long that obstructs line of sight. The wall has 30% of your maximum health and lasts up to 15 sec.

410248.d:
While an enemy player is affected by your Polymorph or Mass Polymorph, your movement speed is increased by 25% and your Versatility is increased by 12%.

Additionally, Polymorph and Mass Polymorph no longer heal enemies. (1s cooldown)

414664.m: Talent · 6% of base mana · Instant · 5 min cooldown
414664.d:
You and your allies within 40 yards instantly become invisible for 12 sec. Taking any action will cancel the effect.

Does not affect allies in combat.

415945.d: The cooldown of Mass Invisibility is reduced by 3 min and it can affect allies in combat.

1220739.d:
Your barriers absorb 60% more damage and have an additional effect, but last 4 sec. [ Frost: Ice Barrier
If the barrier is fully consumed, enemies within 10 yds suffer (650% of Spell Power) Frost damage and are slowed by 70% for 4 sec / Fire: Blazing Barrier
Reflects 40% of damage absorbed /

1953.m: 2% (기본 마나 중) · 즉시 · 20 초 재사용 대기시간 · 1회 사용 가능
1953.d: 전방으로 20미터를 순간이동합니다. 경로에 장애물이 있으면 이동이 중단됩니다. 모든 기절 및 구속 효과에서 벗어납니다.

31661.m: 특성 · 4% (기본 마나 중) · 즉시 · 45 초 재사용 대기시간
31661.d:
전방 부채꼴 12미터 범위 내의 적에게 (주문력의 66.99%)의 화염 피해를 입히고 4초 동안 방향 감각을 상실하게 만듭니다. 피해를 입으면 효과가 사라집니다.

Always deals a critical strike and contributes to Hot Streak.

113724.m: 특성 · 8% (기본 마나 중) · 30 야드 사정거리 · 2 초 주문 시전 시간 · 45 초 재사용 대기시간
113724.d:
10초 동안 대상 지역에 서리 고리를 소환합니다. 고리를 밟는 적은 10초 동안 행동 불가 상태가 됩니다. 최대 10명의 대상에 영향을 줍니다.

행동 불가 효과가 만료되면 4초 동안 적의 이동 속도가 65%만큼 감소합니다.

352278.m: 탱커 스펙 – 1열 PvP 특성 · 8% (기본 마나 중) · 30 야드 사정거리 · 1.5 초 주문 시전 시간 · 1.5 분 재사용 대기시간
352278.d: 시야를 가리는 30미터 길이의 얼음 벽을 생성합니다. 벽은 자신의 최대 생명력의 30%에 해당하는 생명력을 가지며, 최대 15초 동안 지속됩니다.

410248.d:
적 플레이어가 자신의 변이 또는 대규모 변이에 걸리면, 자신의 이동 속도가 25%만큼, 유연성이 12%만큼 증가합니다.

추가로 변이와 대규모 변이가 더는 적의 생명력을 회복시키지 않습니다. (1초 재사용 대기시간)

414664.m: 특성 · 6% (기본 마나 중) · 즉시 · 5 분 재사용 대기시간
414664.d:
자신과 40미터 내의 아군이 즉시 12초 동안 투명 상태가 됩니다. 행동을 취하면 효과가 사라집니다.

전투 중인 아군에게는 영향을 주지 않습니다.

415945.d: 대규모 투명화의 재사용 대기시간이 3분만큼 감소하고 전투 중인 아군에게도 영향을 줍니다.

1220739.d:
방벽 주문이 60%의 피해를 추가로 흡수하고 추가 효과를 발휘하지만 지속시간이 4초가 됩니다. [ 냉기: 얼음 보호막
방벽이 완전히 소진되면 10미터 내의 적에게 (주문력의 650%)의 냉기 피해를 입히고 4초 동안 이동 속도를 70%만큼 감소시킵니다 / 화염: 이글거리는 방벽
흡수한 피해의 40%를 반사합니다 /

note: There is no spec-specific PvP guide source, so these are general principles built from ability and PvP talent tooltips, actual top-player pick rates, and mode and map requirements.

notes: 영웅 특성이 1인 조합전 성난태양 40·서리불꽃 1로 거의 성난태양이지만 한쪽 전용 기술은 쓰지 않음
Blink의 기절·속박 해제는 Blink 툴팁 문구이며 쐐기 파일은 Shimmer 기준이라 Blink 툴팁을 새로 받음. Shimmer로 바꾸면 해제 문구가 없음
투기장 상위권 표본은 3v3 27명·2v2 9명으로 1인 조합전과 같은 세 특성이 거의 전원이라 채택률을 함께 인용
지도 공략상 운반자가 은신·일부 무적 기술을 쓰면 깃발이 떨어지는데 Mass Invisibility 투명화·Ice Block이 여기에 드는지 확인되지 않아 운반 중 사용 권고는 쓰지 않음
